event.title: TangoMelbourne – TANGO LEVEL 1.5
event.description: Push your tango a bit further.  Tango level 1.5 is a combination of Movement sequences, Tango Vals and Tango Milonga.    Sequences are some of the most common and usable sequences so that you are ready to go out and move with others without having to worry about knowing what to do.    In the Vals / Milonga Classes, you will learn the way to dance to Vals & Milonga.    At a Tango Social event (also called a milonga) the music is divided into 3 types.  Tango, Vals, and Milonga (the musical style, not the social event...yes we know its confusing). Although Tango is the majority of the music played the other 2 styles are used every 4 or for tandas (groups of songs)    Tango Vals is a dance in groups of 3 like other valses however, in Tango Vals you will be using your Argentine Tango ideas to make it all happen.    Milonga is where tango started.  It is a dance based in groups of 2 and is the 'fun' more folk style of tango.    Vals / Milonga is all about the fun, getting involved, and discovering more about tango.
